name: Micro Dose
description:
A fictional calculator-era underworld economy. Read the night’s forecast, set price, quantity, quality and distribution, then run the night and see what happened. Illustrated reports follow the results.

Climb six career levels from Runner to Empire. Earn profits, buy districts and fronts, and unlock new distribution routes. Career shows your next unfinished goal. Lay low reduces heat while your fronts still bring in income.

Build the Empire by earning $60,000 net, owning all six districts and three fronts, and keeping heat below 60. You can keep playing afterward. Negative cash or heat at 100 ends the campaign. Up and Down browse; Select edits or acts. Progress saves automatically. No account or connection required.

For Pebble Time 2 and Round 2. Touch requires firmware 4.33.2; button controls remain available. By Luke Steuber.
